post.originalText:
I've been having fun seeing how frontier models compare at elevating a simple design. Each one got the same prompt: "Make this design better. Push what you can do using modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript."

Bottom left is the original. The four others are GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, all at Max effort.

Muse and Gemini 4 coming soon.
